description: This circular walk explores Pinsley Wood in the Hanborough area of Oxfordshire. You can start the walk from the little village of Church Hanborough which lies just to the south of Long Hanborough. In the woods you'll find a series of peaceful trails with lots of woodland birds and pretty bluebells in the spring months. The woods are a fine place for a dog walk too. Also look out for the ancient Grade I listed church in Church Hanborough which dates back over 900 years. The woods are located just south of Woodstock where you could explore the magnificent Blenheim Park .
